title: Beyond Job Titles: Interpreting Early-Career Job Advertisements with Sparse Autoencoders and Semantic Clustering
abstract: arXiv:2611.21586v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Job titles and job descriptions alone provide limited insight into how technical roles differ in a changing job market. To assess how such roles differ in their work and industry applications, we design and compare two methods based on deep learning and transformer representations using 36,081 early-career job postings collected from LinkedIn in the United States between December 2025 and October 2026.   We first apply PERC, short for Preprocessing (P), Embedding (E), Dimensionality Reduction (R) and Clustering (C). We employ GPT-6 Luna to classify job description passages into Team context, Role task and Qualifications. We then create combinations of these sections and examine whether embedding and clustering the segmented passages produce meaningful semantic clusters about different job roles. translated_title: 超越职位头衔：利用稀疏自编码器与语义聚类解读早期职业招聘广告
translated_abstract: 仅凭职位头衔和职位描述，难以充分洞察瞬息万变的就业市场中技术类岗位之间的差异。为评估这些岗位在工作内容和行业应用方面的不同，我们基于深度学习和Transformer表示设计并比较了两种方法，使用了2025年12月至2026年10月期间从美国LinkedIn收集的36,081条早期职业招聘信息。我们首先应用PERC方法，即预处理、嵌入、降维和聚类。我们使用GPT-6 Luna将职位描述段落分类为团队背景、角色任务和任职资格三个部分，然后创建这些部分的组合，并检验对分段文本进行嵌入和聚类是否能产生关于不同岗位角色的有意义语义簇。我们使用最大均值差异（MMD）对嵌入分布之间的观测差异进行排序，并采用预训练的稀疏自编码器……
tldr: 该研究提出基于PERC流程（预处理、嵌入、降维、聚类）并结合稀疏自编码器与语义聚类的方法，对36,081条美国早期职业招聘信息进行分析，超越了职位头衔本身来揭示技术岗位在工作内容与行业应用上的真实差异。
en_tdlr: This study proposes PERC-based methods (Preprocessing, Embedding, Dimensionality Reduction, Clustering) combined with sparse autoencoders and semantic clustering to analyze 36,081 early-career US job postings, revealing how technical roles truly differ in their work and industry applications beyond job titles.
